content: ContainerIPdu . thresholdSize The attribute Container- IPdu . thresholdSize defines the threshold when a ContainerIPdu shall be trig- gered for transmission. If the payload size of the ContainerIPdu exceeds the value of thresholdSize this ContainerIPdu shall be transmitted.
